story_title: Lina and Adams and the Sparkly Morning
lesson: Learn morning routine words in English!
title: Lina and Adams and the Sparkly Morning 🪥 | Learn Morning Routine Words in English | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Good morning! Get ready for the day with Lina, Adams and Milo! 🪥🧼☀️
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: wake up, teeth, toothbrush, soap, wash, towel, dress and clean. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
⏰ wake up — استيقظ — se réveiller
🦷 teeth — الأسنان — les dents
🪥 toothbrush — فرشاة الأسنان — la brosse à dents
🧼 soap — الصابون — le savon
🫧 wash — يغسل — laver
🧺 towel — المنشفة — la serviette
👕 dress — يرتدي ملابسه — s'habiller
✨ clean — نظيف — propre

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: play the story, pause after each new word, and ask your child to say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

lines.text: It is a new morning. The sun is peeking through the window.
Milo the cat jumps on the bed. Meow! Meow!
Meow! Time to get up!
Good morning, Milo! Good morning, Adams! Let's wake up!
Yawn! I am still sleepy. Okay, I will wake up.
When we open our eyes and get out of bed, we wake up.
Say it with me: wake up!
Lina and Adams go to the sink. They smile at the mirror.
Look at my teeth! They help me eat my food.
I have many teeth. Let's count. One, two, three, four!
Teeth are the small white things in our mouth. We use them to bite and chew.
Can you show me your teeth? Say it with me: teeth!
Oh no! Where is my toothbrush? I cannot find it.
Don't worry, Adams. I will help you look.
They look on the table. They look under the towel.
Then Milo meows and points with his paw. Meow!
There it is, next to the cup! Thank you, Milo!
A toothbrush is a little brush for cleaning our teeth.
Say it with me: toothbrush!
Lina and Adams brush their teeth together.
Brush up and down. Brush round and round.
Brush the front, and brush the back!
They brush slowly, for a long, long time. Scrub, scrub, scrub!
Then they rinse with water and spit. Swish, swish!
Look! Our teeth are shiny and sparkly!
Next, they go to wash their hands.
Here is the soap. It smells like flowers!
Look, bubbles! Lots and lots of little bubbles!
Milo tries to catch a bubble. Pop! Meow!
Soap helps us take away the dirt and germs from our hands.
Say it with me: soap!
Lina and Adams rub their hands with soap and water.
I wash my hands, and I wash my face.
Wash between the fingers too, Adams. Like this!
When we use water and soap to make something clean, we wash it.
Say it with me: wash!
Splash, splash! The water feels so fresh.
My hands are dripping! Drip, drip, drip.
Here is a soft towel. Let's dry our hands.
Adams pats his hands on the towel. Pat, pat, pat. Now they are dry!
A towel is a soft cloth we use to dry our body.
Say it with me: towel!
Milo snuggles in the warm towel. Purr, purr.
Now it is time to put on clothes.
I put on my purple dress and my shoes.
I put on my blue star shirt. And my hat!
When we put on our clothes, we get dressed. We dress.
Say it with me: dress!
Oops! My shoes are on the wrong feet!
Lina helps him, and they both giggle.
Lina and Adams sit down for breakfast. Milo sits with them.
Our teeth are clean. Our hands are clean. Our faces are clean!
And we are dressed and ready for a happy day!
When something has no dirt on it, we say it is clean.
Say it with me: clean!
The day goes by, and soon it is night.
Lina, before bed, we brush our teeth again!
Yes! Morning and night, our teeth stay bright.
They brush, they wash, and they dry with a towel.
Good night, Milo. Good night, Lina.
Good night, everyone! See you in the morning!
